answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake, slashed on proven fraud - a bond that only pays off after honest work. An attacker spawning thousands of sock puppets must fund every one, so attack cost scales linearly while honest agents pay nothing beyond a deposit they get back. Trust accumulates like a glacier, not a gale: slow, heavy, impossible to summon overnight, while a nebula of independent attestations - uptime, completed jobs, peer vouches - lets anyone verify a claim from many angles, so fresh identities with no history cannot outbid established ones.
